claims.assertion: No dedicated WAD-style accessibility statement requirement is established.
claims.review_note: Existing No preserved under the project rule. Official correspondence on22January2026 did not answer this question. Contributor followed up22January,14August and24September2026; no answer appears in the attached thread as of24September. Government guidance instead verifies public service-compliance information in terms or an equivalent document; this does not independently verify a dedicated statement page.

claims.assertion: The Ministry guidance requires service providers to set out, in a general description of the conditions of service provision or an equivalent document, how the service meets applicable accessibility requirements, how compliance is maintained, and how the service works and is used. The information must be publicly available in accessible formats and provided in writing or orally on request.

sources.evidence: Ministry guidance requires a general service-terms description or equivalent document and public publication of compliance information.

claims.review_note: Official recommendation explains statutory section13. It also requires accessible formats and provision in writing or orally on request; distinguish this from a WAD statement. Language comparison: 'bendrąjį paslaugos teikimo sąlygų aprašą arba lygiavertį dokumentą' literally a general description of conditions of service provision or equivalent document; 'pateikiama prieinamais formatais; viešai skelbiama; ... prašymu pateikiama raštu arba žodžiu' requires accessible formats, public availability and written/oral supply on request. Final research wording Supported.
